annotations.title: Inbound mail TLS check (MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, DANE)

description: Inbound mail TLS check (MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, DANE) — Check a domain's inbound SMTP transport security. Pass domain=. Reads MX, the _mta-sts TXT record and fetches the https://mta-sts.<domain>/.well-known/mta-sts.txt policy (mode, max_age, mx patterns vs real MX hosts, content type, redirects), TLS-RPT (_smtp._tls) reporting address, DANE TLSA records on the top 3 MX hosts with DNSSEC flag, and BIMI presence. Status ENFORCED/TESTING/DANE ONLY/BROKEN/NOT CONFIGURED, 0-100 score, issues with severity. Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: email_mta_sts
